text: actually scrap all that u know what we can do better. just make some client/server setup and i can run the server on here and then a client on my mac. they can resolve discrepency between code that is up to date and we can then only need to pass back like the singular models that i end up making not the entire code
resolution: Implemented a desktop-authoritative client/server sync instead of Git or full-archive handoffs. The Bun server exposes SHA-256 manifests and read-only code downloads; the Mac client pulls only changed managed files and may push only editor-owned models, maps, and contentstore data. Both directions mirror deletions, retain timestamped backups, and verify exact hashes after transfer.
